speaker: judith_sadler
text: You are early, which in this house is a way of standing in the heat. The shoulder is not out.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We have brought an appetite with us. It can stand until you say.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I said the corner on the way. I am only saying it where the pie can hear me.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: The pie can hear when I say it can. Sit when I point, and not before. Anne, you know the bench.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I know it. Let them stand until the peel comes. They have argued since the lane.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: I am not standing for a corner. The bench is full of flour, and I am not sitting in it.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Wipe it, or sit in it. I am not at the end of this batch.

speaker: judith_shakespeare
text: If we sit in the flour we shall be loaves, and then nobody can eat us before the pie.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wipe the bench. I will not be a loaf before dinner.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: There. Now we are fit to be a nuisance at leisure.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Leisure is a word for a man who does not fire an oven. You will have the shoulder when it is ready, Will, and not a creed sooner.

speaker: judith_sadler
text: And the children will have a bench that is a bench. Sit. The second batch has done its waiting. You may begin yours.
